messages:
Dana R: Noticing weird loop in reconciliation: reporting backfill emitted compensating adjustments and those adjustments triggered the webhook relay which the backfill then re-processed, causing a feedback loop. ~30 invoices impacted between 2026-03-26 23:45-23:55 UTC.

Omar S: Wait, the backfill emits compensating_adjustments and also writes a marker to reporting_repaired. How did the webhook see it as missing?

Ashwin: Initial look: backfill emits a compensating NS line with memo 'report-backfill comp'. We have a downstream webhook that listens to NS invoice updates and republishes to the event bus for downstream reporting. The backfill sets reporting_repaired=true after the NS call, but the webhook consumer reads older snapshot of the DB and thinks the original proration never existed, so it republishes a missing-event which the backfill then re-sees as missing and emits another compensating adjustment. Loop.

Billing Bot: [alert] report-backfill loop detected run=rbf-2026-03-26-23 delta=3040. Check /logs/reports/2026-03-26/backfill.log and /artifacts/2026-03-26/loop-dryrun-2176543211.csv

Dana R: Example logs:

```
2026-03-26T23:46:02Z INFO report-backfill detect missing change change_444 -> emit compensating_adjustment invoice 81012 amount -60 id=ns_1701
2026-03-26T23:46:12Z INFO ns webhook relay received invoice update invoice 81012 -> published event evt_rep_1701
2026-03-26T23:46:15Z INFO report-backfill consumed evt_rep_1701 -> interpreted as missing change -> emit compensating_adjustment invoice 81012 amount -60 id=ns_1702
```

Omar S: Ugh. So two compensating adjustments posted for same logical gap. Querying scope now.

Dana R: Quick DB query:

```
SELECT invoice_num, COUNT(*) as comp_count, SUM(amount) as total_comp
FROM ns_invoice_lines
WHERE memo ILIKE '%report-backfill comp%' AND created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-26 23:40' AND '2026-03-26 23:58'
GROUP BY invoice_num HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
-- returns 30 rows
```

Ashwin: Root cause summary: ordering/visibility race between backfill marking and webhook consumer snapshot reads. Also webhook consumer republishes NS updates without checking the origin.

Revenue Ops: Any customers flagged? CS wants to proactively message anyone with >$75 delta.

Dana R: I generated dry-run CSV at /artifacts/2026-03-26/loop-dryrun-2176543211.csv with invoice, dup_line_ids, amounts. Total duplicate amount $3,040 across 30 invoices.

Omar S: Short-term mitigations I pushed at 23:58 UTC: 1) pause report-backfill auto-repairs, 2) add a guard in webhook-relay that tags events originating from report-backfill (X-Origin: report-backfill) and drop them from backfill consumption, 3) add a 10s debounce to backfill re-check before emitting compensating adjustments.

Ashwin: Long-term: change backfill to perform a final read-after-write (READ COMMITTED) before emitting compensation, and add idempotency token to compensating adjustments so duplicates are easy to dedupe. Filed infra#5568. Also will add an integration test that runs webhook-relay + backfill in a race and asserts no duplicate compensating emits.

Revenue Ops: Please include customer-impact column in the CSV and flag >$75 cases. We'll coordinate CS outreach after Finance reviews.

Dana R: Finance signoff needed for remediation actions (void duplicate compensating NS lines). I prefer voiding the later compensating line if it restores invoice totals. Will prepare signoff sheet.

Billing Bot: [info] dry-run candidates=30 total=$3040. Artifact uploaded.

Omar S: After fixes, we should add a monitoring alert: "reportbackfill-feedback-loop > 3 in 15m". Also add runbook note 'reports/backfill-relay-loop'.

Ashwin: I'll push hotfixes and a backfill to flag other invoices that might have been hit by this pattern across the last 7 days. Dry-run for that backfill will be in /artifacts/2026-03-27/range-flag-2176543211.csv.

Dana R: Thanks. Please don't run any live voids until Finance posts final ack here. I'll review the CSV now and loop in Accounting. :white_check_mark:
